combo_label: At the Doctors × The Circus × Frankenstein

entries.clue: Wash your hands, or pass this invisible little nasty along
Rolled-up foam pad, spread across the ring floor before the tumblers come on
Snowy European range where maker and made meet on a sea of ice
Spread beneath the flying act, so that a missed catch ends in a bounce
Terrifying dream of the sort that first showed the author her story
Powdery timber waste strewn to soften and soak the floor of the ring
Tacky pine powder dabbed on palms so the bar will not slip
Hacking bark from a tickly chest, often worse once you lie down
Mean shack against a cottage wall where the being hides and listens
Wrong designation; calling the being by its maker's is the classic one
Crust that forms over a healing graze; better not picked
Passage a torch and a wooden stick get pointed at when it hurts
